scope: Pi Web abnormal prompt/session interruption recovery
hardGates: Reuse the existing pi-portable launcher, Pi Web API, lop-chain state and bridge retry path
Never replay an interrupted tool call directly from the supervisor
A user cancellation marker always wins over automatic recovery
Persist state before dispatching a recovery prompt
Recover tracked runs after Pi Web process restart
Use a per-session single-flight key and block the third consecutive identical failure
